2116118139582697581.en_summary: U.S. stocks fell sharply pre-market (SPX -1.0%, NDX -2.2%) after weak $INTC and $AMZN results and guidance accelerated a rotation out of tech amid slowing growth. INTC plunged 25% on a soft PC demand outlook projected to persist through mid-2027; AMZN missed overall revenue estimates even as AWS beat and CapEx was higher than expected. Tech peers fell sharply with $NVDA -2.9%, $AVGO -4.0%, $MU -5.2%, and $DELL -10%. Brent crude rose 1.6% to $117/bbl. 10-year yield fell to 4.93% as investors sought safety. BTC dropped 1.5% to $75.6K post Binance’s $6.3B North Korea-linked hack. Gold and silver declined. S&P 2026 EPS estimates remain robust at $369 (+33% YoY) despite the weakness in tech. We remain cautious on $TSLA.
2116118139582697581.zh_summary: 美國股市盤前大幅下跌（標普500指數 -1.0%，納斯達克100指數 -2.2%），因 $INTC 與 $AMZN 業績及指引疲弱，加速科技股資金外流，成長放緩。$INTC 因個人電腦需求展望疲軟（預計持續至2027年中）暴跌25%；$AMZN 整體營收低於預期，儘管AWS表現優異且資本支出高於預期。科技同業大幅下跌：$NVDA -2.9%、$AVGO -4.0%、$MU -5.2%、$DELL -10%。布倫特原油上漲1.6%至每桶117美元。10年期國債收益率跌至4.93%，投資者尋求避險。比特幣下跌1.5%至7.56萬美元，因幣安涉及北朝鮮的63億美元黑客事件。黃金與白銀下跌。標普2026年每股盈利預估仍強勁，達369美元（同比+33%），儘管科技股疲弱。我們對 $TSLA 保持謹慎。
